fusion. The dataset contains 840 paired observations, divided into 672 training and 168 source -separated validation

To prevent information leakage between the 
training and validation sets, the 840 original paired 
observations were partitioned before any 
augmentation. The partitioning was performed using 
source-group-separated stratified sa mpling, where 
observations associated with the same original image 
source were kept within the same partition. The 
source group is identified by the source_id assigned 
during dataset verification. This procedure prevents 
the same source from contributing t o both training 
and validation. 
The resulting partition contains 672 original 
training observations (80%) and 168 original 
validation observations (20%). The validation set was 
fixed throughout all experiments and contained only 
original observations, with  no sensor or random 
visual augmentation. Thus, all configurations were 
evaluated on the same source-separated validation set.

Base, (4) MaxViT -Tiny, (5) ViT + Sensor, and (6)

evaluates the independent predictive capability of the 
three agro -environmental variables, while 
EfficientNet-B0, ViT-Base, and MaxViT-Tiny serve 
as image-only baselines. The proposed ViT + Sensor 
configuration combines the 768 -dimensional visual 
representation with the 64 -dimensional 
environmental representation.

permuted across observations, thereby disrupting the 
original image -sensor corresponden ce while 
preserving the sensor -vector structure and its

evidence.excerpt:
metrics 
All six configurations were evaluated on the same 
fixed set of 168 original validation observations 
obtained through source -separated partitioning. No 
sensor or random visual augmentation was applied 
during validation. Predictions were generated using 
the selected checkpoint for each configuration. 
Model performance was assessed using accuracy, 
macro-averaged precision, recall, and F1 -score, 
balanced accuracy, Cohen's kappa, and Matthews 
correlation coefficient (MCC). Macro averaging was 
used to assign equal importance to the four canonical 
classes. Balanced accuracy was calculated as the 
mean class -wise recall, while Cohen's kappa and 
MCC provided complementary measures of 
agreement and correlation beyond accuracy. 
In addition to record -level evaluation, source -
level performance was assessed by aggregating 
predicted class probabilities for observations

missing_information: No reproducible review or selection methodology was detected.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The headline outcome is measured against ground-truth labels on a fixed source-separated validation split, and the shuffled-sensor control corroborates the null incremental effect of sensor correspondence.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Ground-truth class labels on a fixed, source-separated validation set of 168 observations, reported via accuracy, macro F1, balanced accuracy, MCC, and Cohen's kappa.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Multiclass cross-entropy loss against ground-truth disease labels, optimized with AdamW.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims are strictly aligned with empirical observations; the paper clearly states that environmental data contains predictive signal in isolation (71.43% accuracy) but that multimodal integration does not demonstrate incremental accuracy gain over vision-only models.
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluation includes standard classification metrics across six configurations on a held-out source-separated validation set of 168 instances. The authors report that image-only baselines already saturate the benchmark at 100% accuracy, transparently confirming that multimodal fusion yields no incremental performance benefit under this test setup.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Evaluation is conducted using objective ground-truth category matching on a held-out source-separated validation split, supplemented by a shuffled-sensor negative control.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Classification accuracy, macro F1, balanced accuracy, MCC, and Cohen's kappa on a fixed, source-separated validation set using ground-truth class labels.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Standard supervised cross-entropy loss against ground-truth disease class annotations optimized using AdamW.

primary.limitations: The authors explicitly address limitations regarding dataset scope, ceiling effects on the validation partition, lack of cross-plantation and external environmental evaluation, and the need for more visually ambiguous field scenarios.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, describing network architectures, source-group-separated stratified partitioning to prevent data leakage, training-only data augmentations, and rigorous controls such as shuffled-sensor pairing.
primary.quality_rationale: The study demonstrates high methodological rigor, includes negative/neutral control outcomes (shuffled sensor and zero incremental gain over vision-only baselines), avoids overclaiming, provides reproducible artifacts, and accurately reports the boundaries of its contribution.
primary.scoped_contribution: The manuscript presents a multimodal feature-fusion framework combining a Vision Transformer (ViT-Base) with an MLP encoding three agro-environmental sensor variables (humidity, soil moisture, pH) for coffee leaf disease classification, evaluated against unimodal baselines and a shuffled-sensor control on a source-partitioned dataset.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The study demonstrates high methodological rigor, includes negative/neutral control outcomes (shuffled sensor and zero incremental gain over vision-only baselines), avoids overclaiming, provides reproducible artifacts, and accurately reports the boundaries of its contribution.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors explicitly address limitations regarding dataset scope, ceiling effects on the validation partition, lack of cross-plantation and external environmental evaluation, and the need for more visually ambiguous field scenarios.

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.

research_relevance.value: Directly relevant to computer-vision research based on screening evidence.
